name: MCP Canary
tagline: Inspect any remote MCP server without calling its tools
description: A remote, read-only MCP server that connects to any public MCP endpoint and reports its transport (Streamable HTTP or legacy SSE), protocol version, server info, tools with input and output schemas, and a side-effect class per tool from its MCP hints. Target problems come back as stable failure codes. No tool on the target is ever called. A second tool returns the plans and prices of MCP Canary, the synthetic monitoring service behind it.
